behavior: Wades in shallow water, alternating patient stalking with active running, wing-flicking, and foot-stirring to flush fish and other small aquatic prey. Often nests colonially with other herons.
field_marks: Yellow eyes and yellow facial skin at the bill base
Long black legs with bright yellow feet
Slim body with a long, flexible neck
Broad, rounded white wings and a short white tail
habitat: Shallow fresh, brackish, and saltwater habitats, including marshes, tidal flats, estuaries, mangroves, swamps, ponds, river and lake margins, beaches, and flooded fields.
